episodes.synopsis: After Kamishiro Maiku recognizes a house on television that appears in a photo that was left to him by his parents, he decides to go live there. Then two girls show up on his door step to move in, claiming to his twins.
episodes.title: The Twins are Three People?

episodes.synopsis: Maiku has the same unusual blue eyes and the same childhood photograph as the girl at his door. They might be related.
episodes.title: We may be blood relatives

episodes.synopsis: Maiku has strong feelings about not abandoning a relative, so Miina can stay until they know otherwise.
episodes.title: We may be strangers

episodes.synopsis: Miina drags Karen along to a job interview so they can help with bills.
episodes.title: Be nice to you

episodes.synopsis: Karen and Miina begin attending Maiku's school and discover rumors that Maiku doesn't like girls circulate.
episodes.title: Do you like girls

episodes.synopsis: Maiku worries as the girls attempt to avoid him so they don't have to discuss their changing feelings.
episodes.title: Love Alliance

episodes.synopsis: After winning the grand prize in a lottery, Maiku, Miina and Karen head to the beach.
episodes.title: Making memories

episodes.synopsis: Maiku learns the truth of Shimazaki's sexuality. Shimazaki reunites with Tsubaki, whom he was previously in love with.
episodes.title: Love should be honest

episodes.synopsis: On a beautiful day, the three head to the mall, but end up getting lost from each other.
episodes.title: Don't Get in Our Way

episodes.synopsis: Maiku and Karen learn of Miina's past. Karen then find out that the picture of Maiku and one of the girls was taken at a different angle.
episodes.title: We'd like to run again

episodes.synopsis: Karen goes on a date with Maiku before telling the others that they're siblings.
episodes.title: We want to tell you we like you

episodes.synopsis: Miina runs away, twice. But Maiku won't let her go so easily.
episodes.title: Three People Twins
